mainEntity.name: How quickly will I see results from a Website Audit for Google AI Overviews?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for seeing results from a Website Audit for Google AI Overviews can vary. Some improvements, especially related to content clarity and structured data, might show initial positive signs within weeks. However, significant shifts in AI Overview appearances and associated traffic typically take several weeks to a few months, as Google's AI systems need time to re-crawl, process, and re-evaluate your updated content. Consistent monitoring and iterative adjustments are often part of the ongoing strategy to maintain and improve visibility.
